correctness.rationale: An equivariant integral cochain splitting gives exactly ten components. Five pair stabilizers act by -1, five triple stabilizers by +1, yielding the two induced lattices. Their self-duality transfers to H1. Their restriction to a reflection has Z_+ plus Z_- plus four regular C2 lattices, giving mod-two rank four, whereas the regular Z[D5] lattice gives five. Verification code exhaustively confirms the representation and cubical cellular ranks.
